title_short: Comcast CTV :30 · Fuel Our Shared Future (QR)
headline: A young person’s potential is already inside her. Your $42 a month brings it out. Scan the code and give.
story: A 30-second TV spot that runs on Comcast streaming (Roku, Hulu, Tubi) in Manhattan from 1 Nov to 1 Dec. The viewers are adults who give. They watch on a TV with their phone in hand. The QR code sits in the corner from 0:03 to the end, so anyone who is moved can scan at once.

It is your V1, cut down to 30 s, with BUILD in it now. Heart first: an NFTE student says what is inside her, a BUILD student says what BUILD gave him, the narrator asks the viewer to invest over NFTE and BUILD students pitching and a mentor on the steps, two students say <q>Fuel a future like mine</q>, and the end card asks for $42 a month. NFTE asked us to spend the seconds on why it matters and why to give now, not on who NFTE is.

LOOPS: L1 <q>What is inside her, and what brings it out?</q> opens 0:00, closes 00:06.4 when the BUILD student says support gave him his confidence. L2 <q>Who gives that support?</q> opens 0:00, closes in the BUTTON: the narrator’s <q>someone like you</q>, a mentor on the steps, and the girl from the hook asking us herself. STAKES: talent without support stays inside.

No city names. No shot where a sign reads a city.
Don’t go over 30 s. Not even one frame. Don’t use BUILD shots with their own graphics burned in.

decisions.b: Melanie’s BUILD videos have no one saying “Fuel a future like mine”, so the BUILD student speaks right after the hook with the strongest BUILD-impact line: “If it wasn’t because of Build, I don’t think that I would have the confidence I have now.” In BUILD’s own video it plays over his smiling portrait. If NFTE wants a BUILD voice in the closing lines instead, the swap is “I want to be CEO of my own life.” from BUILD’s 2026 Comcast spot (that shot has their big text burned in).

Comcast’s content rules ask a donation ad for a "Paid for by" or "Sponsored by" line, and the order needs proof of 501(c)(3) status. The end card says "Paid for by Network for Teaching Entrepreneurship (NFTE)". Denise confirms the wording and sends the proof with the order.

NFTE’s give page says new gifts are matched 25% through Britebound. A line like "Your gift is matched" makes the ask stronger, but only if NFTE confirms the match runs through 1 Dec. Not in the cut until they say yes.
Not chosen yet. Atdhe owes it.
